prompt: What holds Na+ and Cl- together in sodium chloride?

options.text: A pair of electrons shared between them
The nucleus of one atom moving into the other
Nothing; the ions only sit next to each other

explanation: Na+ is positive and Cl- is negative. Opposite charges attract. This attraction between ions is an ionic bond. Sharing electrons is a different kind of bond.

prompt: What is the total charge of one unit of sodium chloride, NaCl?
explanation: The +1 charge of Na+ and the -1 charge of Cl- cancel out, so NaCl has no overall charge. The electron moved from sodium to chlorine; none were made or lost.
